review.why: Builds a sourced literature review from Firecrawl's paper index: search, related papers and in-paper checks.
review.summary: Uses Firecrawl Research tools to search paper abstracts, expand from seed papers (similar, citers, references), fetch metadata and verify a specific claim inside a paper, with web search as fallback. It explains what the index covers (mostly biomedical literature plus arXiv) and returns a literature review outline.
strengths: Says exactly what the paper index covers and what it does not
Expands to the whole paper family, not just the first hit
Verifies load-bearing claims inside the paper body
cautions: Needs a Firecrawl API key and its research tools
Coverage is mostly biomedical and arXiv, thinner elsewhere
